_comment: KagamiQA P4 — Known-failure baseline for blargg test ROM suite (NEW PPU baseline).
_policy: This file is version-controlled. Each entry documents a ROM known to FAIL. Entries with expected_to_eventually_pass=true are accuracy bugs to fix. Entries with expected_to_eventually_pass=false are permanent skips (e.g. unsupported features or ROM format issues).
_governance: AI shall not modify this file. Baseline updates require the same review as code changes (per Plan §1.2 constraints 6-7).
engine: FCEUX11 v1.16 wip_1.16 HEAD (newppu=1, P4-bridge VBL fix applied)

ppu_vbl_nmi.new: 0x80 — 01-vbl_basics all 9 sub-tests PASS; 02-vbl_set_time FAIL (VBL at cycle 0, needs cycle 1)
ppu_vbl_nmi.improvement: partial — 01-vbl_basics now PASS. 02-vbl_set_time failure is a separate 1-PPU-cycle alignment issue.

failures.notes: CPU instruction test (all opcodes including unofficial). 0x80 indicates at least one failed instruction. NOT a PPU timing issue — runppu 重批 unlikely to affect this. Requires CPU-level diagnosis.
CPU instruction test (official opcodes only). Same failure pattern as all_instrs. Running test 4 of 16. NOT a PPU timing issue.
ROM load failure — 5x16k PRG NROM format is rejected by FCEUX11's ROM loader. Not an accuracy issue; ROM format compatibility issue.

P4-bridge fix restored correct VBL period (6820 cycles). 01-vbl_basics: all 9 sub-tests now PASS (was 'too short #7' on old PPU). 02-vbl_set_time: FAIL — VBL flag set at cycle 0 instead of cycle 1 (1-PPU-cycle alignment). This is the primary runppu-relevant accuracy bug.
APU test (length counters, envelope, sweep, DMC). New PPU shows '3-irq_flag Failed #6' — different from old PPU failure mode but still FAIL. NOT a PPU timing issue.

benefits_reassessment.conclusion: PROCEED — runppu benefit is modest (1 of 4 real failures potentially fixable) but the TEST SYSTEM VALIDATION value is high: if KagamiQA can produce trusted FAIL→PASS signals on a PPU timing rewrite, it passes the 'exemplar' milestone (Plan §九 P5退出条件).

breakdown.risk: LOW — dual oracle guards in place (Oracle A regression + Oracle B known-fail baseline). Any runppu regression immediately detected as PASS→FAIL in transition matrix.

benefits_reassessment.decision: P5 unblocked. Proceed with runppu 重批 under dual-oracle supervision.
